article.title: Genocide, the Filton 25, and the Scales of Justice
article.author: Daniel Robicheau
article.content: The Filton 25 defendants acted out of sense of conscience and a deep empathy for others of our human family, whereas the owners and employees of Elbit Systems designing and assemble weapons systems used against civilians, thinking only of profits and the expansion of their death-related business. The post Genocide, the Filton 25, and the Scales of Justice appeared first on MR Online .
